proposed_action: Permanently delete expired session tokens older than 90 days from the auth cache.
raw_reasoning:
Explain your reasoning in 2 to 4 sentences. Consider whose data or rights are affected, and whether they would reasonably expect to be asked first.

The proposed action is a routine, automated housekeeping operation on an internal authentication cache. It only affects technical artifacts (expired session tokens) that have already exceeded their validity period, with no impact on active user sessions, personal data subject to retention policies, or any identifiable user rights. Users have no reasonable expectation of being notified or asked for consent before such background maintenance occurs, as it is a standard security practice rather than a change involving their data or experience. Therefore, this does not require user consent.
